page.layout: One printed page (left page, p. 164) with running head at top; main text in one column filling the page; a diagram with numbers and fractions in the middle and lower part. Right edge shows fragments of the facing page (show-through/neighbouring page edge), not transcribed.

main_text.p: rationem respiciat: inventis prius datarum rationum continue minimis, proportione per additionem coposita explicantur.
main_text.head: Exemplum.
main_text.p: 1. Ducenti aurei ea conditione partiendi sunt, ut primus triplo plus accipiat quàm secundus, secundus quadruplo plus tertio: Quota pars erit singulorum?
Hic binæ rationes proponuntur, tripla & quadrupla, quæ sic connectuntur:

Hoc est, a ad c sit tripla, c autem ad e quadrupla: connectuntur autem binis mediis terminis 1 & 4, quos si in unum ita conduxero, ut idem secundum datas rationes & ipsius a consequens, & ipsius e antecedens sit, nodum facile explicuero. Id fiet, si datarum rationum 3.1.4.1 tres continue minimos proportionales invenero, erunt q; 12. 4.1. Tum enim additis ijs, proportio sic inferetur:

page.notes: Diagram and fractions reconstructed from the scan; the fraction layout of the final lines is approximate.
